items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: McGee which I went to see many times.

ctx.x: Let’s say this was the bill. You know, I’m not saying this was the bill, you have Joan Baez, Pete Seeger, Peter, Paul & Mary, Benny Goodman and an unknown folk singer. And so if I went to that, I went to hear Benny Goodman. Even though Peter, Paul & Mary and Joan Baez and all these others are famous people, I’ll tolerate them because they’re famous, I want to hear what they have to do, but I’m going to be sitting on my hands for three hours waiting for the Benny Goodman or whatever, Sonny Terry and Brownie

McGee which I went to see many times. That’s what I want to see. So I’m not going to encourage an encore. I’m trying to get rid of this thing. But because he became famous so fast I remembered it was him.
